result.stdout:
Description:
  gxnext — CLI client for the GeneXus MCP server.

Usage:
  gxnext [command] [options]

Options:
  -s, --server <server>     MCP server URL (default: $GXNEXT_MCP_SERVER env var or http://127.0.0.1:1989/mcp).
  -q, --quiet               Filtered output: only [ERROR]/[WARNING] lines, section starts and the final ✓/✗ (default).
  -v, --verbose             Print every progress message verbatim.
  --json                    Emit machine-readable JSON. For tool calls: one event per line. For list-tools: a single array.
  --refresh-tools           Bypass the local tools cache and re-fetch the tool list from the server.
  --no-autostart            Do not auto-start the MCP server if it is unreachable on a loopback URL.
  --allow-version-mismatch  Operate the KB with the running MCP even if its major.minor differs from the KB's (e.g. to upgrade/convert an older KB with a newer GeneXus). Otherwise such a mismatch is refused.
  --mcp-version             Print the version reported by the MCP server (connecting to it, auto-starting if needed) and exit.
  --version                 Show version information
  -?, -h, --help            Show help and usage information

Commands:
  list-tools  List the MCP tools the server currently exposes.
